With both opponent creatures tapped (no blockers), attacking Stoneforge Mystic and casting Battlefield Improvisation (1W available from Sacred Foundry + Sunbaked Canyon) would attach Colossus Hammer (+10/+10), Shadowspear (+1/+1, trample, lifelink), Leyline Axe (+1/+1, double strike, trample), and Paradise Mantle to the attacking Mystic. That makes it a 15/16 with double strike and trample, dealing 30 damage — more than enough to kill the opponent at 14 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with Stoneforge Mystic as a 1/2, dealing only 1 damage and not casting Battlefield Improvisation.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Stoneforge Mystic, then in combat cast Battlefield Improvisation targeting it, attaching all Equipment (Colossus Hammer, Shadowspear, Leyline Axe, Paradise Mantle) for lethal damage with double strike.

annotations.description: Soul Spike can be cast for free by exiling two black cards from hand, dealing 4 damage and gaining 4 life. With the opponent at 9 life, Soul Spike represents a significant chunk of damage that could help close out the game. The player has Soul Spike in the graveyard already, plus this one in hand, and multiple black cards that could fuel the alternate cost. Discarding it removes a potential 4-damage burst that could be critical for finishing the opponent. While the mana cost of 7 is prohibitive, the alternate cost of exiling two black cards from hand is very achievable - the player has Fatal Push x2 and could draw more black cards. At 9 life, the opponent is in Soul Spike range if combined with Psychic Frog attacks.
annotations.actionTaken: Discarded Soul Spike to Psychic Frog's end-of-turn cleanup/discard trigger
annotations.betterLine: Discard a Swamp or Undercity Sewers instead. The player already has 5 lands on the battlefield and 4 more land cards in hand - they have far more lands than needed. Keeping Soul Spike preserves the option to deal 4 damage for free by exiling two black cards (like the two Fatal Pushes if removal isn't needed), which could represent lethal alongside Psychic Frog attacks against an opponent at 9 life.

annotations.description: Missed lethal. With both opponent creatures tapped and opponent at 11 life, casting Puresteel Paladin would activate Metalcraft (4 artifacts on board), allowing free equip of Colossus Hammer, Shadowspear, and Leyline Axe to Stoneforge Mystic for a massive double-striking, trampling, lifelinking attack that deals well over 11 damage unblocked.
annotations.actionTaken: Attempted to use Stoneforge Mystic's activated ability instead of recognizing the lethal line through Puresteel Paladin.
annotations.betterLine: Play Sacred Foundry (untapped), cast Puresteel Paladin (WW), achieve Metalcraft, equip Colossus Hammer + Shadowspear + Leyline Axe to Stoneforge Mystic for free, attack for lethal with double strike and trample.

annotations.description: Paid 2 life on Sacred Foundry to enter untapped (going from 8 to 6 life) against an aggressive board with Psychic Frog and Emperor of Bones. The player's reasoning was based on a hallucinated Puresteel Paladin on the battlefield, believing they could equip Colossus Hammer for free. Without Puresteel Paladin, the extra untapped mana is less critical, and preserving life at 8 rather than 6 would provide more buffer against the opponent's threats.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Sacred Foundry untapped, paying 2 life to go from 8 to 6 life.
annotations.betterLine: Play Sacred Foundry tapped to stay at 8 life, since without Puresteel Paladin the extra mana this turn is less likely to enable a game-winning play, and staying at higher life is important against the opponent's aggressive creatures.

annotations.description: Playing Undercity Sewers (enters tapped) instead of Polluted Delta or Swamp delays casting Sheoldred, the Apocalypse by a full turn. With the opponent at 6 life, Sheoldred is devastating - it's a 4/5 deathtouch that drains the opponent whenever they draw. Additionally, cracking Polluted Delta would enable Revolt for Fatal Push to kill up to MV 4 creatures like Stoneforge Mystic.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Undercity Sewers, which enters tapped, leaving only 3 available mana this turn and delaying Sheoldred.
annotations.betterLine: Play Polluted Delta, crack it for a Swamp (enabling Revolt for Fatal Push), then cast Sheoldred, the Apocalypse with 4 mana (BBUB). This puts immediate lethal pressure on the 6-life opponent and stabilizes ESPN's life total.

annotations.description: Battlefield Improvisation provides lethal damage this turn. Stoneforge Mystic is attacking into no blockers. Casting Battlefield Improvisation (1W, payable with Plains + Sacred Foundry) gives +2/+2 and attaches all Equipment: Colossus Hammer (+10/+10), Shadowspear (+1/+1, trample, lifelink), Leyline Axe (+1/+1, double strike, trample), Paradise Mantle. That's 15 power with double strike and trample = 30 damage against 11 life. This is lethal.

annotations.betterLine: Cast Battlefield Improvisation targeting the attacking Stoneforge Mystic to attach all Equipment and deal lethal damage with double strike
